content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make cinnamon pancakes, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Grease the griddle with butter (30 seconds)
Step 2. Flip the pancakes to cook the other side (2 minutes)
Step 3. Retrieve the large mixing bowl (10 seconds)
Step 4. Measure out the all-purpose flour (45 seconds)
Step 5. Whisk the dry ingredients together (30 seconds)
Step 6. Take the flour container out of the pantry (15 seconds)
Step 7. Set the table with plates and silverware (2 minutes)
Step 8. Melt the butter in the microwave (45 seconds)
Step 9. Pour the batter onto the hot griddle (1 minute)
Step 10. Measure the baking powder (20 seconds)
Step 11. Sift the flour to remove lumps (1 minute)
Step 12. Crack the eggs into a small dish (30 seconds)
Step 13. Whisk the melted butter into the milk (30 seconds)
Step 14. Mix the cinnamon swirl topping in a small bag (2 minutes)
Step 15. Check the milk expiration date (10 seconds)
Step 16. Wash your hands thoroughly (40 seconds)
Step 17. Pour the milk into the wet ingredients bowl (15 seconds)
Step 18. Plug in and preheat the electric griddle (5 minutes)
Step 19. Combine the wet and dry ingredients (1 minute)
Step 20. Whisk the batter until just combined (45 seconds)
Step 21. Measure out the whole milk (30 seconds)
Step 22. Beat the eggs lightly with a fork (20 seconds)
Step 23. Get the butter from the refrigerator (15 seconds)
Step 24. Add a pinch of salt to the flour (10 seconds)
Step 25. Place the greased griddle on the stove (10 seconds)
Step 26. Measure out the granulated sugar (20 seconds)
Step 27. Find the maple syrup in the cupboard (20 seconds)
Step 28. Monitor for bubbles forming on the surface (3 minutes)
Step 29. Stir the batter one last time (15 seconds)
Step 30. Warm the maple syrup (1 minute)
Step 31. Get the ground cinnamon from the spice rack (20 seconds)
Step 32. Pour the syrup into a small serving pitcher (30 seconds)
Step 33. Whisk the flour, sugar, and baking powder (40 seconds)
Step 34. Ladle the first scoop of batter (20 seconds)
Step 35. Prepare a side of fresh berries (5 minutes)
Step 36. Test the griddle temperature with a drop of water (10 seconds)
Step 37. Clear the workspace of unnecessary items (1 minute)
Step 38. Get the spatula out of the drawer (10 seconds)
Step 39. Put away the whisk (30 seconds)
Step 40. Measure the ground cinnamon (30 seconds)
Step 41. Wipe down the kitchen counter (2 minutes)
Step 42. Open the sugar container (10 seconds)
Step 43. Clean the butter melting dish (2 minutes)
Step 44. Remove the pancakes and place on a plate (30 seconds)
Step 45. Put the sugar and salt back in the pantry (1 minute)
Step 46. Drizzle the cinnamon swirl over the cooking batter (1 minute)
Step 47. Check that the griddle surface is clean (15 seconds)
Step 48. Put the milk back in the fridge (20 seconds)
Step 49. Sift the cinnamon into the dry mix (45 seconds)
Step 50. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients (15 seconds)
Step 51. Locate the cinnamon jar (15 seconds)
Step 52. Double check the measurements (1 minute)
Step 53. Get a medium bowl for wet ingredients (15 seconds)
Step 54. Smell the cinnamon to ensure freshness (5 seconds)
Step 55. Locate the cooking spray or butter for the pan (20 seconds)
Step 56. Open the spice cabinet (10 seconds)
Step 57. Ensure the spatula is clean and dry (15 seconds)
Step 58. Wait for the griddle "ready" light (2 minutes)
Step 59. Add a dash of vanilla extract to the batter (15 seconds)
Step 60. Check the kitchen timer (5 seconds)
